summary: Sherard married Martha Lips in 1886, seven years before Wilde's trials and three years into his friendship with Wilde. Wilde asked after her warmly in 1888.
certainty_reasoning: Married: stated by the editors of the Complete Letters.

sources.quote: He had married a Polish girl called Martha Lips in 1886.
sources.context: Merlin Holland and Rupert Hart-Davis, editors' note to Wilde's [? 1888] letter to Sherard, in a note otherwise concerned with dating the letter from Sherard's contributions to the Table.
sources.supports: The marriage and its year — the whole of what the source says about it.
sources.provenance: PDF page 369; printed folio 347 confirmed on the rendered page image.

sources.quote: How is your pretty, romantic looking wife with her lovely eyes?
sources.context: Wilde to Sherard, [? 1888], 16 Tite Street — the only description of her anywhere in this corpus.
sources.speaker: Oscar Wilde
sources.supports: That Wilde knew her, and how he spoke of her.
sources.provenance: PDF page 370; printed folio 348 confirmed on the rendered page image.
